title: Novartis delivered sales growth in Q2 and further advanced pipeline; full-year guidance reaffirmed
evidence: Q2 2026 net sales USD 14.408B (+1% cc, +3% USD); core operating income USD 5.940B (flat); operating margin 33.0%. [primary IR release]

title: Novartis Q2 2026 net income and core EPS
evidence: Net income USD 3.257B (-19%); core EPS USD 2.41 (-1% cc).

title: Q2 2026 growth-driver brand sales
evidence: Q2: Kisqali USD 1.695B (+43%), Cosentyx USD 1.824B (+10%), Kesimpta USD 1.424B (+32%), Scemblix USD 562M (+89%), Pluvicto USD 651M (+43%), Leqvio USD 480M (+59%).

title: Entresto sales decline in Q2 2026 from US generic entry
evidence: Entresto Q2 2026 sales USD 1.181B, down 51% in constant currencies reflecting US generic competition.

title: Novartis reaffirms full-year 2026 guidance
evidence: Net sales expected to grow low single-digit; core operating income expected to decline low single-digit (cc).

title: Q2 2026 pipeline milestones: Fabhalta IgAN, Itvisma SMA, Rhapsido CSU
evidence: FDA approval of Fabhalta for IgAN; EC approval of Itvisma gene therapy for broad SMA population; EC/Japan approval of Rhapsido for CSU.

title: Novartis delivered strong growth in priority brands and launches in Q1; FY 2026 guidance reaffirmed
evidence: Q1 2026 net sales USD 13.113B (-5% cc, -1% USD) as US generic erosion outweighed priority-brand growth; core operating income USD 4.897B, 37.3% margin.

title: Q1 2026 priority-brand performance
evidence: Q1: Kisqali USD 1.516B (+55%), Pluvicto USD 642M (+70%), Kesimpta USD 1.164B (+26%), Leqvio USD 452M (+69%), Fabhalta USD 169M (+103%); Entresto USD 1.305B (-46%).

title: Q1 2026 pipeline: remibrutinib CHMP opinion, ianalumab Breakthrough, Fabhalta IgAN data
evidence: Positive CHMP opinion for remibrutinib in CSU; ianalumab FDA Breakthrough Therapy for Sjogren's; Fabhalta Phase III showed 49.3% reduction in kidney function decline in IgAN.

title: Novartis delivered high single-digit sales growth and 40% core margin in 2025
evidence: FY2025 net sales USD 54.5B (+8% cc); core operating income USD 21.9B (+14% cc); core operating margin 40.1%, up 210bps.

title: FY2025 net income, EPS and free cash flow
evidence: FY2025 net income USD 14.0B (+19% cc); core EPS USD 8.98 (+17% cc); free cash flow USD 17.6B (+8%).

title: FY2025 full-year brand sales
evidence: FY2025: Cosentyx USD 6.7B (+8%), Kisqali USD 4.8B (+57%), Kesimpta USD 4.4B (+36%), Pluvicto USD 2.0B (+42%), Scemblix USD 1.3B (+85%).

title: Novartis raises dividend for 29th consecutive year and adds USD 10B buyback
evidence: Dividend CHF 3.70/share (+5.7%), 29th consecutive increase; USD 8.9B repurchased in 2025 plus new USD 10B buyback authorization.

title: CEO frames 2026 as growing through largest patent expiry in Novartis history
evidence: CEO: 'we expect to grow through the largest patent expiry in Novartis history, underscoring the strength of our business.'

title: Novartis projects +5-6% cc sales CAGR 2025-2030, backed by 30+ high-value pipeline assets
evidence: Projects +5-6% cc sales CAGR 2025-2030; return to 40%+ core margin by 2029; 30+ potential high-value medicines.

title: Eight in-market brands with USD 3-10B peak sales potential
evidence: Eight de-risked brands (Kisqali, Cosentyx, Kesimpta, Pluvicto, Scemblix, Leqvio, Fabhalta, Rhapsido); Kisqali peak raised to USD 10B+, Scemblix to USD 4B+.

title: Novartis targets core margin above 40% two years ahead of plan
evidence: Delivered 41.2% core operating margin in first nine months of 2025, two years ahead of plan; 15+ submission-enabling readouts over next two years.

title: Novartis completes USD 12B acquisition of Avidity Biosciences
evidence: Completed acquisition of Avidity for USD 72.00/share (~USD 12B fully diluted); adds muscle-directed AOC platform and three late-stage neuromuscular programs.

title: Novartis agrees to acquire Avidity Biosciences (announcement)
evidence: Novartis agreed to acquire Avidity, innovator in RNA therapeutics, strengthening late-stage neuroscience pipeline and xRNA strategy.

title: Novartis raises USD 11B in bonds to fund Avidity acquisition
evidence: Novartis sold USD 11B of investment-grade bonds, maturities three to 30 years, to fund the Avidity acquisition.

title: Novartis to acquire Tourmaline Bio for pacibekitug in ASCVD
evidence: ~USD 1.4B deal at USD 48/share for Tourmaline Bio; adds pacibekitug, an anti-IL-6 antibody for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

title: Novartis agrees to acquire Excellergy for up to USD 2B in anti-IgE immunology deal
evidence: Deal up to USD 2B adds Exl-111, a next-generation anti-IgE antibody, extending Novartis allergy/immunology franchise; expected to close H2 2026.

title: Novartis acquires Anthos Therapeutics for abelacimab (cardiovascular)
evidence: Novartis acquired Anthos Therapeutics, adding Phase III abelacimab for stroke/systemic embolism prevention; USD 925M upfront plus up to USD 2.15B milestones.

title: FDA approves Pluvicto for earlier pre-chemotherapy use in mCRPC
evidence: FDA approved Pluvicto pre-chemotherapy in PSMA-positive mCRPC; reduced risk of radiographic progression or death by 59%; roughly triples eligible patients.

title: FDA approves Rhapsido (remibrutinib), first oral BTKi for chronic spontaneous urticaria
evidence: Rhapsido is the first FDA-approved BTK inhibitor for CSU in adults symptomatic despite H1 antihistamines; first oral option versus prior injectables.

title: FDA grants traditional approval to Fabhalta for primary IgA nephropathy
evidence: FDA approval of Fabhalta (iptacopan) as first complement inhibitor shown to significantly slow kidney function decline in primary IgAN at risk of progression.

title: Novartis plans USD 23B US manufacturing and R&D expansion
evidence: USD 23B over five years, 10 facilities (7 new), ~1,000 Novartis jobs plus ~4,000 additional; ensures all key US medicines made in the US.

title: Novartis finalizes US expansion with seventh new facility in North Carolina
evidence: Seventh new US facility in Morrisville, NC, a 56,200-sq-ft API site for solid dosage and RNA therapeutics; five-site RLT network coast-to-coast.

title: Chai Discovery collaborates with Novartis on AI-driven antibody discovery
evidence: Novartis gains access to Chai's AI models including Chai-3 for therapeutic antibody discovery across multiple targets; financial terms not disclosed.

title: Novartis signs ~USD 1B AI protein-therapeutics deal with Generate:Biomedicines
evidence: Novartis partnership with Generate:Biomedicines, up to ~USD 1B, using generative AI to discover and develop protein-based therapeutics across multiple targets.

title: Novartis modernizes clinical development with AWS and Accenture AI platform
evidence: GXP-compliant data platform with AWS and Accenture; reported 72% query-speed improvement, 60% storage-cost reduction, 160+ hours manual work eliminated.

title: Novartis broad Kisqali early-breast-cancer label pressures Lilly's Verzenio
evidence: Kisqali's broad early breast cancer label covers node-negative patients, separating it from Lilly's Verzenio; analysts see the two neck-and-neck.

title: Cosentyx faces intensifying IL-17/IL-23 competition and 2029/2030 patent cliff
evidence: Cosentyx competes with Skyrizi, Tremfya, Bimzelx and Taltz; anticipated patent expiry 2029 (US) and 2030 (EU) opens biosimilar competition.

title: Kisqali US exclusivity secured to at least 2031 via patent settlement
evidence: Novartis settled a Kisqali (ribociclib) patent challenge ensuring US exclusivity until at least 2031.

title: Novartis sues generic makers over Entresto '918 patent
evidence: Novartis sued Mylan, Alembic, Crystal, MSN and Nanjing Noratech alleging infringement of its Entresto '918 patent set to expire November 2026.

title: Novartis loses bid to block US Entresto generics; generics launch late July 2025
evidence: Federal Circuit lifted the injunction July 22, 2025; with pediatric exclusivity expired, multiple generic Entresto launched end of July.

title: Novartis pure-play innovative-medicines strategy across five therapeutic areas
evidence: Pure-play Innovative Medicines company focused on cardiovascular, immunology, neuroscience, solid tumors and hematology, key tech platforms and the US market.

title: Avidity xRNA/AOC platform advances Novartis RNA therapeutics strategy
evidence: USD 12B bet on RNA drugs; Avidity AOCs target myotonic dystrophy type 1 (del-desiran), FSHD (del-brax) and Duchenne muscular dystrophy (del-zota).

title: Pluvicto HSPC approval expected Q3 2026 to expand eligible pool ~75%
evidence: Pluvicto's next growth phase hinges on expected Q3 2026 approval in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, expanding the eligible pool ~75%.

title: Novartis Kate Therapeutics acquisition for AAV gene therapies
evidence: Acquired Kate Therapeutics (AAV gene therapies for muscle/heart diseases) for USD 427M cash plus up to USD 700M milestones.
